SELECT "c".name, "c".location, "c".country, "r".year, "p".duration AS "pit_stop_length" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MAX(milliseconds) FROM "pitstops") LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(COUNT("q".q3)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid), 0), 2) AS "average_q3_lap_times" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "qualifying" AS "q" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1992-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "qualifying_1_times" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN (SELECT forename FROM "drivers" GROUP BY forename HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS "shared" ON "shared".forename = "d".forename WHERE "d".code IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM("q".q1), '') IS NOT NULL AND CAST("q".q1 AS INTERVAL) > INTERVAL '2 minutes' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref, COALESCE(SUM("r".points), 0) AS "total_points" FROM "drivers" AS "d" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "res".driverid, "res".points FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT driverid, raceid FROM "laptimes") AS "l" ON "l".driverid = "res".driverid AND "l".raceid = "res".raceid) AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename = 'Robert' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".driverref LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".date, "d".forename, "d".surname, ("f".fastest_ms / 60000)::TEXT || ':' || TO_CHAR(("f".fastest_ms % 60000) * INTERVAL '1 millisecond', 'SS.MS') AS "fastest_lap_time" FROM "races" AS "r" LEFT JOIN (SELECT raceid, driverid, MIN(milliseconds) AS "fastest_ms" FROM "laptimes" WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL GROUP BY raceid, driverid HAVING MIN(milliseconds) > 90000) AS "f" ON "f".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "f".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'French Grand Prix' AND "r".year >= 1990 ORDER BY "r".date ASC, "d".surname ASC, "d".forename ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND "d".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND (split_part("q".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(split_part("q2".q3, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + split_part("q2".q3, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "d2".driverid = "q2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'British' AND "d2".dob >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '' AND "q2".q3 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "d".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1976-01-01' AND "r".rank = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "ranked".name, "ranked".career_points, "ranked".url AS "introduction_website" FROM (SELECT "c".name, COALESCE(SUM("season_points".points), 0) AS "career_points", "c".url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM("season_points".points), 0) DESC) AS "career_rank" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "r".date DESC, "r".raceid DESC) AS "season_row" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid) AS "season_points" ON "season_points".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "season_points".season_row = 1 WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url) AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".career_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "ranked".career_rank ASC, "ranked".name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "d".forename = 'Peter' THEN "d".driverid END) AS "Peter", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "d".forename = 'John' THEN "d".driverid END) AS "John" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".forename IN ('Peter', 'John') AND "r".position = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("q".q3), '') IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE NULLIF(TRIM("q2".q3), '') IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".nationality, COUNT(DISTINCT "r".constructorid) AS "constructor_count" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".constructorid = "c".constructorid AND "r".rank = 1 GROUP BY "c".nationality ORDER BY "c".nationality ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, COUNT("p".stop) AS "total_pit_stops" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "ds".raceid FROM "driverstandings" AS "ds" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "ds".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Australian' AND "ds".position BETWEEN 1 AND 19) AS "qualifying_races" ON "qualifying_races".raceid = "r".raceid LEFT JOIN "pitstops" AS "p" ON "p".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013 GROUP BY "r".year ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "number_of_drivers" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND "r".date < DATE '1996-01-01' AND CASE WHEN "q".q1 ~ '^[0-9]+:[0-5][0-9]([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC > 120 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_name", "p".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01' AND "p".milliseconds = (SELECT MIN("p2".milliseconds) FROM "pitstops" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "p2".raceid WHERE "r2".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r2".date < DATE '2016-10-01') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "full_name", "d".nationality, "r".name AS "first_win_race", "r".date AS "first_win_date", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "results" AS "career" INNER JOIN "races" AS "cr" ON "cr".raceid = "career".raceid WHERE "career".driverid = "d".driverid AND "cr".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 AND "career".grid > 0) AS "races_started" FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "win" ON "win".driverid = "d".driverid AND "win".position = 1 INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "win".raceid WHERE "r".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "d".dob ASC NULLS LAST, "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname ASC, "r".date ASC, "r".name ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "c".name AS "constructor_name" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "constructors" AS "c" ON "c".constructorid = "q".constructorid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "q".raceid AND "res".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q2) <> '' ORDER BY (SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) ASC, CASE WHEN "res".grid > 0 THEN "res".grid END ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q2) <> '' AND (SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) = (SELECT MIN(SPLIT_PART("q2".q2, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q2".q2, ':', 2)::NUMERIC) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "r2".raceid = "q2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "q2".q2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q2) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT "q2".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '' ORDER BY CAST(SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q2".q3, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) ASC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND "q".q3::INTERVAL = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3::INTERVAL) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "r".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q2".q3) <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "res".time AS "runner_up_time_gap" FROM (SELECT raceid, year FROM "races" WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix' AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009 AND time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time ASC, year DESC LIMIT 1) AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid AND "res".position = 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time AS "finish_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time::TIME <= TIME '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("q".q3) <> '' AND CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) < 98 LIMIT 501

SELECT "early".circuitref AS "earliest_circuit_reference", "late".circuitref AS "latest_circuit_reference", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("late".start_time - "early".start_time)) AS "gap_seconds" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MIN("r2".time::TIME) FROM "races" AS "r2" WHERE "r2".time IS NOT NULL)) AS "early" CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time::TIME = (SELECT MAX("r2".time::TIME) FROM "races" AS "r2" WHERE "r2".time IS NOT NULL)) AS "late" ORDER BY "early".circuitref ASC, "late".circuitref ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < '1990-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("r".fastestlapspeed) <> '' GROUP BY "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".dob ORDER BY MAX("r".fastestlapspeed::NUMERIC) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND ("q".q2 IS NULL OR TRIM("q".q2) = '') ORDER BY CASE WHEN "q".q1 IS NULL OR TRIM("q".q1) = '' THEN NULL ELSE SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 1)::NUMERIC * 60 + SPLIT_PART("q".q1, ':', 2)::NUMERIC END DESC NULLS LAST, "q".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) AS "drivers_withdrew" FROM "results" AS "res" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "res".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1962 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid) FILTER (WHERE "s".status = 'Finished' OR "s".status ~ '^[+][0-9]+ Laps?$') / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "res".driverid), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".year = 1957 AND "r".name = 'British Grand Prix' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("e".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAST("e".expense_date AS DATE)) IN (9, 10) GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_expenses" LIMIT 501

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "difference" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN "b".amount ELSE 0 END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN "b".amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "ratio" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' AND "e".event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting') LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".amount) <> 0 AND SUM("b".spent)::NUMERIC / SUM("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("r".ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent)::NUMERIC / SUM("b2".amount) AS "ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id HAVING SUM("b2".amount) <> 0) AS "r") LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) > 7 LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, "m".phone FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member FROM "expense" WHERE cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM "expense")) AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "soccer".attendees AS "soccer_attendees", "semester".rounded_average AS "average_fall_2019_attendees", CASE WHEN "soccer".attendees > "semester".rounded_average THEN 'more' WHEN "soccer".attendees < "semester".rounded_average THEN 'fewer' ELSE 'equal' END AS "verdict" FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendees" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "soccer" CROSS JOIN (SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_counts".attendees), 1) AS "rounded_average" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendees" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_counts") AS "semester" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".department, COUNT(DISTINCT "d".major_id) AS "majors_offered", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".member_id IS NOT NULL THEN "d".major_id END) AS "majors_held_by_members", ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "d".major_id), 0), 2) AS "average_members_per_major" FROM "major" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".link_to_major = "d".major_id WHERE "d".department IN (SELECT "c".department FROM "major" AS "c" WHERE "c".college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') GROUP BY "d".department ORDER BY "d".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type AS "event_type", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended", COALESCE((SELECT SUM("b".amount) FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".type = "e".type AND "e2".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e2".event_date < '2020-01-01'), 0) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".department, COALESCE(SUM("i".amount), 0) AS "total_dues" FROM "major" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "member" AS "mb" ON "mb".link_to_major = "m".major_id AND "mb".position = 'Member' AND "mb".member_id IN (SELECT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a") LEFT JOIN "income" AS "i" ON "i".link_to_member = "mb".member_id AND "i".source = 'Dues' WHERE "m".college IN (SELECT college FROM "major" WHERE department = 'Electrical and Computer Engineering Department') GROUP BY "m".department ORDER BY "m".department ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".first_name, "m".last_name, ROUND(SUM("b".amount - "b".spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_amount_left" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "e" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".budget_id = "e".link_to_budget WHERE "e".cost > 50 GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name ORDER BY total_amount_left DESC, "m".last_name ASC, "m".first_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("i".amount) AS "total_dues" FROM "income" AS "i" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".link_to_member FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "a".link_to_event WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game') AS "attendees" ON "attendees".link_to_member = "i".link_to_member WHERE "i".source = 'Dues' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m".major_name) AS "majors_without_enrolled_members" FROM "major" AS "m" WHERE "m".college IN (SELECT "tyler_major".college FROM "member" AS "tyler" INNER JOIN "major" AS "tyler_major" ON "tyler".link_to_major = "tyler_major".major_id WHERE "tyler".first_name = 'Tyler' AND "tyler".last_name = 'Hewitt') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "major" AS "same_name_major" INNER JOIN "member" AS "enrolled" ON "enrolled".link_to_major = "same_name_major".major_id WHERE "same_name_major".college = "m".college AND "same_name_major".major_name = "m".major_name) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_attendance".attendee_count), 2) AS "average_attendees" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "b".category = 'Advertisement' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT "mj".major_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "a".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj" ON "mj".major_id = "m".link_to_major WHERE "e".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "mj".major_id, "mj".major_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "m".member_id) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".member_id) FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "m2".member_id = "a2".link_to_member INNER JOIN "major" AS "mj2" ON "mj2".major_id = "m2".link_to_major WHERE "e2".event_name = 'Football game' GROUP BY "mj2".major_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".member_id) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY "mj".major_name ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "member" WHERE "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id)) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE is_officer), 2) AS "average_events_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(event_count) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_officer), 2) AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM (SELECT "m".member_id, COALESCE("m".position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer'), FALSE) AS "is_officer", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_event) AS "event_count" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) AS "member_attendance" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LOWER(TRIM(split_part(replace("e".expense_description, ' - ', ','), ',', "n".n)))) AS "count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "over_budget" ON "over_budget".link_to_event = "b".link_to_event AND "over_budget".amount - "over_budget".spent < 0 CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4) AS "n" WHERE TRIM(split_part(replace("e".expense_description, ' - ', ','), ',', "n".n)) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE("w".water_cost, 0)::NUMERIC / "a".attendee_count, 2) AS "water_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) AS "attendee_count" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "water_cost" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%water%' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "w" ON "w".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN "college_departments".department IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) AS "in_college", COUNT(CASE WHEN "college_departments".department IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS "not_in_college" FROM "member" LEFT JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT department FROM "major" WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences') AS "college_departments" ON "major".department = "college_departments".department LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "cb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x".cost > 0) AS "chip_events" ON "chip_events".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING MAX("b".amount) = (SELECT MAX("b2".amount) FROM "budget" AS "b2" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "cb2".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "cb2" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x2" ON "x2".link_to_budget = "cb2".budget_id WHERE "x2".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%' AND "x2".cost > 0) AS "chip_events2" ON "chip_events2".link_to_event = "b2".link_to_event) LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date, SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' GROUP BY "e".expense_date ORDER BY "e".expense_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".type AS "event_category", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "ma".college, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id GROUP BY "ma".college HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(college_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "college_count" FROM "member" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma2" ON "m2".link_to_major = "ma2".major_id GROUP BY "ma2".college) AS "counts") ORDER BY "ma".college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "qualifying_budget" ON "qualifying_budget".link_to_event = "e".event_id AND "qualifying_budget".amount > 40 INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_amount_budgeted" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "b".link_to_event INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "pb".link_to_event FROM "budget" AS "pb" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "pb".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description = 'Pizza') AS "p" ON "p".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-10-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("event_spending".total_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_spending" LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budget", SUM("b".spent) AS "total_spending" FROM "budget" AS "b" GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "totals" ON "totals".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM(1 + LENGTH("x".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("x".expense_description, ',', ''))) AS "purchases" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "counts" ON "counts".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' AND COALESCE("totals".total_spending, 0) <= COALESCE("totals".total_budget, 0) ORDER BY COALESCE("counts".purchases, 0) DESC, "e".event_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_members" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e".type HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX("t".member_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a2" ON "a2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e2".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e2".type) AS "t") LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN "n".n = 1 THEN TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 1)) WHEN "n".n = 2 THEN TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 2)) ELSE TRIM(SPLIT_PART("e".expense_description, ',', 3)) END AS "item_name", "b".category AS "budget_category", SUM("e".cost::NUMERIC) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id INNER JOIN "event" AS "v" ON "b".link_to_event = "v".event_id INNER JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS "n") AS "n" ON "n".n <= 1 + LENGTH("e".expense_description) - LENGTH(REPLACE("e".expense_description, ',', '')) WHERE "v".event_name = 'October Meeting' AND "e".approved = 'true' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2 ASC, 1 ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE("b".total_budgeted, 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COALESCE("a".members_attended, 0) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, SUM(amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "budget" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS "members_attended" FROM "attendance" GROUP BY link_to_event) AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "m".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "e".expense_description LIMIT 501

SELECT full_name, kind_count, total_spending FROM (SELECT "m".first_name || ' ' || "m".last_name AS "full_name", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'donuts' THEN 'donut' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'muffins' THEN 'muffin' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'shirts' THEN 'shirt' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'post cards' THEN 'post card' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'posters' THEN 'poster' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'cookies' THEN 'cookie' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) END) AS "kind_count", MAX("s".total_spending) AS "total_spending", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'donuts' THEN 'donut' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'muffins' THEN 'muffin' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'shirts' THEN 'shirt' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'post cards' THEN 'post card' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'posters' THEN 'poster' WHEN LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) = 'cookies' THEN 'cookie' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n))) END) DESC) AS "rnk" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "m".member_id = "e".link_to_member INNER JOIN (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(cost) AS "total_spending" FROM "expense" WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND expense_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY link_to_member) AS "s" ON "s".link_to_member = "e".link_to_member CROSS JOIN (SELECT 1 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS "n" UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS "n") AS "n" WHERE "e".expense_date >= '2019-10-01' AND "e".expense_date < '2019-12-01' AND TRIM(split_part(REPLACE(REPLACE("e".expense_description, 'Bakery - ', ''), 'Club shirts', 'shirts'), ',', "n".n)) <> '' GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".first_name, "m".last_name) AS "ranked" WHERE rnk = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "ma".major_name) AS "number_of_different_majors" FROM "member" AS "m" INNER JOIN "major" AS "ma" ON "m".link_to_major = "ma".major_id WHERE "ma".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour, COUNT(*) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "c".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "neutral_percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "neutral_marvel_superheroes" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT(*) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "s2".publisher_id WHERE "p2".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') AND "p2".publisher_name <> "p".publisher_name) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p".publisher_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "e".colour AS "eye_colour", "h".colour AS "hair_colour", "sk".colour AS "skin_colour", "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "e" ON "e".id = "s".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "h" ON "h".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "sk" ON "sk".id = "s".skin_colour_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "e".colour = "h".colour AND "e".colour = "sk".colour AND "e".colour <> 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm > 0 AND "s".id IN (SELECT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".power_id NOT IN (SELECT "dc_hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "dc_hp" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "dc" ON "dc".id = "dc_hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dc_p" ON "dc_p".id = "dc".publisher_id WHERE "dc_p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc_hp".power_id IS NOT NULL)) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "power_count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hs".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hs" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "ss" ON "ss".id = "hs".power_id WHERE "ss".power_name = 'Super Strength') AS "strength" ON "strength".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT("strength".hero_id) > 0 AND COUNT(*) = COUNT("strength".hero_id)) AS "exclusive_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') OR "a".alignment IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id) DESC) AS "power_rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' GROUP BY "sp".id, "sp".power_name) AS "ranked" WHERE power_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "ha2".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" ON "ha2".hero_id = "s2".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "s2".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "a2".attribute_name = 'Intelligence') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "h".id, "h".gender_id FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "h".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "h".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue' GROUP BY "h".id, "h".gender_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) >= 10) AS "s" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY "g".gender ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "ha".attribute_value IN (SELECT "hulk_attribute".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_attribute" ON "hulk_attribute".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "hulk_strength" ON "hulk_strength".id = "hulk_attribute".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "hulk_strength".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "different_superpowers" FROM (SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS "height_rank" FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL AND height_cm <> 0) AS "ranked" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "ranked".id WHERE "ranked".height_rank <= 10 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "character_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE ("s".race_id IS NULL OR "r".race IS NULL OR "r".race = '-') AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT("hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "r".race = 'God / Eternal' AND "g".gender = 'Male' GROUP BY "s".id) AS "hero_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("portfolio".power_count), 1) AS "average_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "shared".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "shared" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo_power" ON "cryo_power".power_id = "shared".power_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "cryo" ON "cryo".hero_id = "cryo_power".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "cryo".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name = 'Cryokinesis') AS "eligible" ON "eligible".hero_id = "hp".hero_id GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "portfolio" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "marvel".eye_colour_id FROM "superhero" AS "marvel" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mp" ON "mp".id = "marvel".publisher_id WHERE "mp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_colours" ON "marvel_colours".eye_colour_id = "dc".eye_colour_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "dc".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".race_id = (SELECT "a".race_id FROM "superhero" AS "a" WHERE "a".superhero_name = 'A-Bomb') AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "superhero" AS "f" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "f".gender_id WHERE "f".race_id = "s".race_id AND "g".gender = 'Female') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "publisher" AS "p" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "s" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "p".publisher_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("p".publisher_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" WHERE "h".publisher_id IN (SELECT "b".publisher_id FROM "superhero" AS "b" WHERE "b".superhero_name = 'Blackwulf' AND "b".publisher_id IS NOT NULL) AND "h".id IN (SELECT "h2".id FROM "superhero" AS "h2" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other" ON "other".eye_colour_id = "h2".eye_colour_id AND "other".publisher_id <> "h2".publisher_id WHERE "other".publisher_id IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "x".race, "x".superhero_count FROM (SELECT "r".race, COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count", DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS "race_rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id WHERE "r".race IS NOT NULL AND "r".race <> '-' AND "s".publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM "superhero" WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler') GROUP BY "r".id, "r".race) AS "x" WHERE "x".race_rank = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value), 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch')) AS "powered_heroes" ON "powered_heroes".hero_id = "ha".hero_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ha".attribute_value IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id)) FILTER (WHERE "g".gender = 'Male'), 2) AS "male_average", ROUND(AVG((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" WHERE "hp".hero_id = "s".id)) FILTER (WHERE "g".gender = 'Female'), 2) AS "female_average" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' AND TRIM("s".full_name) ~ '[[:alpha:]]+[[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]]+' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)), 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0)), 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0)), 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm), 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "shared" ON "shared".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0 AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".skin_colour_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "sp".power_name = 'Flight' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT hero_id FROM "hero_power") AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "superpower_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg > 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id WHERE "r".race = 'Human' AND "s".height_cm > 0 ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(power_count) AS "largest_number_of_superpowers" FROM (SELECT "s".id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "s".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg > 0) GROUP BY "s".id) AS "lightest_heroes" LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eyes".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour <> 'Brown') AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "h" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eyes" ON "eyes".id = "h".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "hair".id = "h".hair_colour_id GROUP BY "eyes".colour HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "hair".colour = 'Brown') > 0 ORDER BY hero_count DESC, "eyes".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND TRIM("s".full_name) <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "hp".hero_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_hp" ON "target_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "target_hp".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man') AS "shared" ON "shared".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0 THEN "p".id END)::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5 THEN "p".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE ("p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0) OR ("p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".hct >= 52 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".description IS NULL AND "l".crp LIKE '%+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory") AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

SELECT "l"."T-BIL", "l".date, "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory") AND "l"."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-BIL") FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE CASE WHEN "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l2".rnp::NUMERIC END = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) FROM "laboratory")) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 10 ELSE FALSE END) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) AS "anti-RNP titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("r".rnp AS NUMERIC)) FROM "laboratory" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "r".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s2" ON "s2".id = "r".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' AND "s2".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s2".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "r".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "r".rnp <> 'negative') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' GROUP BY "p".id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 THEN 1 END) > 0 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CASE WHEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 5 THEN 1 END END) > 0) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id))::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna::NUMERIC) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".sex = 'F' AND "p2".admission = '+') ORDER BY "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 16 ELSE FALSE END GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h".id = "p".id AND ("h".hct <= 29 OR "h".hct >= 52) INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id AND CASE WHEN "r".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "r".rnp::NUMERIC > 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS NUMERIC)) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "had normal platelet result", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "never had normal platelet result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE plt > 100 AND plt < 400) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '^[[:space:]]*(RA[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*SJS|SJS[[:space:]]*,[[:space:]]*RA)[[:space:]]*$' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp::NUMERIC - 8.5), 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND diagnosis !~* 'SLE[[:space:]]+susp') AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE elevated = 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM (SELECT "p".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp = '256' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "elevated" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id) AS "tested" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) AS "women", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "men" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "youngest_age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 64 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_without_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE 'Psoriatic arthritis' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".thrombosis > 0 AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(first_exam_date - first_visit_date)) AS "average_delay_days" FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p"."First Date" AS "first_visit_date", MIN("e"."Examination Date") AS "first_exam_date" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".id, "p"."First Date") AS "patient_delays" LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_out_of_range", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".admission, "l".id, "l"."T-CHO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("l2"."T-CHO") FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = "p".admission) ORDER BY "p".admission ASC, "l".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id, CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) AS "anti-RNP level" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS BIGINT) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("l2".rnp AS BIGINT)) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p2"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501
SELECT AVG(hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" WHERE date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') AND hct IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN "p".id END) AS "admitted", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '-' THEN "p".id END) AS "outpatient" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".ra IN ('-', '+-') LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND ("e".kct = '+' OR "e".rvvt = '+' OR "e".lac = '+') WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "e".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "result_date" FROM "laboratory" WHERE sc170 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY id) AS "r" ON "l".id = "r".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "r".id AND "s".date = "r".result_date WHERE "l".date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "s".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "u" ON "u".id = "p".id WHERE "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND "u"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND CASE WHEN "l".dna ~ '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)[[:space:]]*$' THEN CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) < 8 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC END) AS "highest_anti_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE cre < 1.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY sex ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND rnp::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX(rnp::NUMERIC) FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligible_patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT("l".ldh) AS "normal_ldh_measurements" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l".ldh < 500 WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patients_with_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL OR TRIM("p".sex) = '' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

SELECT "x".id, "x".sex, "x".max_rnp FROM (SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, MAX(CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC END) AS "max_rnp" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".sex HAVING MIN("l".hgb) < 10) AS "x" WHERE "x".max_rnp = (SELECT MAX("y".max_rnp) FROM (SELECT "p2".id, MAX(CASE WHEN "l2".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l2".rnp::NUMERIC END) AS "max_rnp" FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".admission = '-' GROUP BY "p2".id HAVING MIN("l2".hgb) < 10) AS "y") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MIN("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id) AND "l".got < 60 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC > 10 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l".date IS NOT NULL AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 4 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "e".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 0 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp IN ('0', '1', '4', '15', '16', '64', '256') THEN "l".rnp::INTEGER > 0 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".birthday AS "Birthday" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC >= 16 ELSE FALSE END) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "p".id, "p".birthday ORDER BY MAX("l".gpt) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".pt < 14 AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) >= 16 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("l".date, "p".birthday)) AS "age", "p".diagnosis FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna ~ '^[[:space:]]*[+-]?([0-9]+([.][0-9]*)?|[.][0-9]+)[[:space:]]*$' ORDER BY CAST("l".dna AS NUMERIC) DESC, "l".date ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([.]|[^[:alnum:]_]|$)' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "r".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC >= 4 ELSE FALSE END) AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL AND "l".date IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC LIMIT 1) >= 2000 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna AS "highest anti-DNA test result" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN "l2".dna ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN "l2".dna::NUMERIC END) FROM "patient" AS "p2" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p2".id WHERE "p2".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)') GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis, "l".dna LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".igg > 900 AND "l".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC NULLS LAST, igg ASC) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN "p".id END) AS "difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "p".id) AND CASE WHEN "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "l".rnp::NUMERIC >= 32 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND CAST("l".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 64 AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".date = (SELECT MAX("l2".date) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" WHERE "l2".id = "l".id AND "l2".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l2".date IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' AND diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]_])SLE[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]_]|$)' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l1" ON "l1".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l2" ON "l2".id = "p".id WHERE "l1".ldh >= 500 AND "l2"."U-PRO" IN ('100', '300', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE "First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND admission IN ('+', '+(') AND birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE("First Date", birthday)) DESC, id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_ac_l_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis = 'SLE' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "male_patients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') AS "female_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc < 3.5) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM"::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average anti-cardiolipin IgM" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SJS([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "p".diagnosis !~* '(^|[^[:alnum:]])SJS[[:space:]]+susp([^[:alnum:]]|$)' AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "female_patients" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ~ '(^|,)[[:space:]]*SjS[[:space:]]*(,|$)' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "sm_lab" ON "sm_lab".id = "p".id AND "sm_lab".sm IN ('negative', '0') INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id AND "e".thrombosis = 0 INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "p".id AND (CASE WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO"::NUMERIC >= 30 ELSE "protein_lab"."U-PRO" IN ('+1(30)', '+2(100)', '>=300', '>=1000') END) LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "thrombosis_exam" ON "thrombosis_exam".id = "p".id AND "thrombosis_exam".thrombosis <> 0 WHERE "thrombosis_exam".id IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "a" ON "a".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND ("r".rbc <= 3.5 OR "r".rbc >= 6.0) AND CASE WHEN "a".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN CAST("a".rnp AS NUMERIC) > 0 ELSE FALSE END LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday))), 1) AS "average_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC >= 64 ELSE FALSE END) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" WHERE wbc > 3.5 AND wbc < 9.0 AND (fg <= 150 OR fg >= 450) AND CASE WHEN rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN rnp::NUMERIC > 15 ELSE FALSE END AND id IN (SELECT id FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "l".date >= "p".birthday AND "l".date < "p".birthday + INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501
