SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'o' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'i' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 's' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "a".element IN ('i', 's') AND "b".bond_type = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "atom" WHERE element IN ('p', 'br')) AS "p" ON "p".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "chlorine_percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "b" ON "a".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "fraction", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE("b".other_bonds, 0) = 0 THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END AS "molecule_group", SUM(CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 1 WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END) AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN (SELECT molecule_id, SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type = '-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS "other_bonds" FROM "bond" GROUP BY molecule_id) AS "b" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id GROUP BY CASE WHEN COALESCE("b".other_bonds, 0) = 0 THEN 'every bond is a single bond' ELSE 'all other molecules' END ORDER BY molecule_group DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "atom" AS "aa" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "mm" ON "mm".molecule_id = "aa".molecule_id WHERE "mm".label = '+'), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT "ranked".element FROM (SELECT "a2".element, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "a2".atom_id) DESC) AS "element_rank" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "m2".molecule_id = "a2".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT atom_id FROM "connected" UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected") AS "endpoints" ON "endpoints".atom_id = "a2".atom_id WHERE "m2".label = '+' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "ranked" WHERE "ranked".element_rank = 1) GROUP BY "a".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN "m".label = '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT("b".bond_id) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' THEN "b".bond_id END) AS "count" FROM "bond" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#') GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY CASE "b".bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "s" ON "s".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "s".element = 's' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT MIN(molecule_id) AS "molecule_id" FROM "atom" WHERE element <> 'na' GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) AS "unique_elements" ON "unique_elements".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' GROUP BY "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "molecule_count" FROM (SELECT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') WHERE "a".element = 'n' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id HAVING COUNT("b".bond_id) = 0) AS "eligible" LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '+') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "carcinogenic_percent", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".label = '-') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "non_carcinogenic_percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '#') AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label IN ('+', '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".element = 'c' OR "y".element = 'c' THEN "b".bond_id END) DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank", "m".molecule_id, "m".label, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "number_of_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "number_of_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'c' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "number_of_carbon_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "a".atom_id END) AS "number_of_chlorine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "x".element = 'c' OR "y".element = 'c' THEN "b".bond_id END) AS "carbon_touching_bonds", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN "b".bond_id END) AS "number_of_multiple_bonds" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "x" ON "x".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "y" ON "y".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'c' THEN "a".atom_id END) > 0 ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "h" ON "h".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "y" ON "y".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "h".element = 'h' AND "y".element = 'y' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(bond_count), 2) AS "average_bonds" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a2".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id AND "a1".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 AND "a2".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') AND "a1".element = 'c' GROUP BY "a2".element LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a1".element <= "a2".element THEN "a1".element || ':' || "a2".element ELSE "a2".element || ':' || "a1".element END) AS "element_pair_count", "m".label FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY bond_count DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "a".element, COUNT("s".atom_id) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "c".atom_id FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "c".atom_id HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') > 0 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) = 0) AS "s" ON "s".atom_id = "a".atom_id GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "triple_atom".element FROM "atom" AS "triple_atom" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "triple_atom".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AS "triple_elements" ON "triple_elements".element = "a".element GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
